## 更新内容 / Changes

- 每个实例可以保存是否注入网络代理，并在启动确认页为本次启动切换。支持 Codex 桌面 / CLI、Claude Code CLI 和 Claude Desktop；旧实例保持原有默认行为。
- 关闭客户端代理注入不会改变本地 API 网关的账号上游出口。实例恢复与 Claude 订阅凭据续期沿用本次启动的选项。
- 默认取消管理器的 60 秒首响等待限制，HTTP / SSE 与 WebSocket 均支持“0 秒 = 不限”。保留流式空闲检测、连接握手超时和用户取消清理。
- 升级会将旧默认 60 秒首响设置迁移为不限时；其他自定义时限保留。新版中主动设置的时限在备份恢复后继续保留。

- Instances can save whether to inject a network proxy and override that choice for a single launch. Supports Codex desktop / CLI, Claude Code CLI and Claude Desktop; existing instances keep their previous default behavior.
- Disabling client proxy injection preserves the local API gateway's account egress configuration. Recovery and Claude subscription renewal retain the active launch choice.
- Removed the manager's default 60-second response-opening limit. HTTP / SSE and WebSocket support “0 seconds = unlimited”, while stream idle checks, connection handshake timeouts and cancellation cleanup remain active.
- Upgrades migrate the old 60-second defaults to unlimited and preserve other custom limits. Explicit limits chosen in this version survive backup restoration.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）DMG / ZIP 和 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。有运行实例时请保留后台服务，待工作结束、管理器完全退出后再切换新版。账号、实例、会话和本地配置保留。未提供应用内自动更新、Developer ID 签名或公证；Windows、Linux 和其他架构未经验证。

DMG / ZIP and `SHA256SUMS.txt` are provided for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64). Keep background services running during active work and switch after the manager has fully exited. Accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. In-app auto-update, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures are not validated.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

延续 Codex 桌面 / CLI、Claude Code CLI 和 Claude Desktop 独立实例支持，客户端需单独安装。关闭注入后，Claude Desktop 的原生网络及组织设置仍由客户端管理。本次不额外宣称真实付费账号登录或模型请求的端到端验证。

Continues support for Codex desktop / CLI, Claude Code CLI and isolated Claude Desktop instances, installed separately. Claude Desktop's native and organization network settings remain client-owned when injection is disabled. This release does not add claims of real paid-account sign-in or model-request end-to-end verification.

## 验证来源 / Verification

源码回归 1545 项通过，5 项已安装客户端相关检查按环境条件跳过；Go sidecar、Responses handlers、代理开关界面、超时设置、退出保活及会话浏览烟测通过。首响测试使用虚拟时间覆盖超过 61 秒等待与取消清理。

源码对应 [v0.15.22 标签](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/tree/v0.15.22)。构建记录见 [Build release 工作流](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/actions/workflows/release.yml)，安装包摘要见附件 [SHA256SUMS.txt](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/releases/download/v0.15.22/SHA256SUMS.txt)。

Source regression: 1,545 passed and 5 environment-conditional installed-client checks skipped. Go sidecar, Responses handlers, proxy controls, timeout settings, background lifetime and session browsing smoke checks passed. Virtual-time tests cover response opening beyond 61 seconds and cancellation cleanup.

Source is available at the [v0.15.22 tag](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/tree/v0.15.22), with build records in [Build release](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/actions/workflows/release.yml) and artifact hashes in [SHA256SUMS.txt](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/releases/download/v0.15.22/SHA256SUMS.txt).
